about: Colour rules of this prototype. The percentages are our team's own choice, not official limits. The keep-out radii follow NASA's 2011 recommendations for U.S. heritage sites (Section A1-3: 2.0 km around lander sites, 0.5 km around impact sites); applying them to every landed or impact site and scaling them by lander class is our own choice.
